newsitem.title: USA: IAS Comm, Emergent launch joint venture.
newsitem.headline: IAS Comm, Emergent launch joint venture.

text.p: IAS Communications Inc and Emergent Technologies Corp said Monday they launched a joint venture called the Eclipse Antenna Manufacturing Co to manufacture the Contrawound Toroidal Helical Antenna.
The antenna is the size of a postage stamp and operates on cellular frequencies. The companies said it has outperformed conventional antennas by more than 300 percent.

The companies said the joint venture is in response to industry interest. They said they received their first order from a leading company in the automatic meter reading industry and is in talks with four other potential customers.
The customer will use the first batch of antennas in pilot meter reading systems in various U.S. areas.
